description: Hop-2 message of the source-driven rebuild fan-out. Fired per dependent SearchIndex after a source table/view emits a TABLE_STATUS_EVENT(AVAILABLE). The worker calls rebuildIfStale, which re-checks the index state under the per-entity write lock and runs a full rebuild when it is WAITING_FOR_SOURCE (first-availability) or when it is ACTIVE and the source's content version has changed since the last build (live data-sync); it no-ops otherwise. The target SearchIndex id travels in objectId. Does not migrate between stacks.
